pro_course_detail.title: Californian Accent Course / American Pronunciation Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak English even more like an American? Then you have found the right teacher. I specialize in pronunciation and will show you how to pronounce English with MY accent. If you are an actor, businessperson, interpreter, teacher, diplomat, or just wanting to expand your ability to mimic Americans for whatever reason, these classes are for you. These classes are primarily for advanced speakers that already have a high intermediate or advanced ability in English phonology.  I WILL NOT TEACH YOU THE 'CLEAREST' ENGLISH! I teach you how native speakers where I'm from REALLY speak (NOT THE SURFER/VALLEY GIRL/BRO ACCENT!), rather than an unnatural, prescribed, international, or 'newscaster' pronunciation. Be ready for a challenge, there will be many surprises. 
This course consists of 4 chapters that teach and have practice for every technique used by those I grew up with when we speak to each other. 
The course is based on the book 'Rhythm and Intonation of American English' by Amanda Lillet. As we learn the different theories in the book, we will do additional practice with my own materials for the section covered in the book with the aid of my own phonemic writing system. Although we will go linearly through the course, you will learn and practice things that are covered and emphasized in previous and following sections. Once we have finished the first three chapters, we can do a wide range of activities and be creative and personalized in how we practice that will continually change your accent to be ever more Californian. 
My other goals as a tutor are to be your native speaker connection, answer any questions you might have, share resources, encourage you, give you study tips, teach you slang/idioms/expressions, and get you to continue improving your abilities with English. You will receive access to over $100 of materials just for taking one class with me. I will also share with you other resources to practice. 
We will use Italki classroom! Not Zoom!

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel stuck at your current English level and are feeling a plateau? I will show you how to bring your English to the next level, from B1 to B2, B2 to C1, and C1 to C2.  Hint: YOU CAN'T KEEP DOING THE SAME THING! I will show you what techniques to implement to start drastically improving your English. You will learn what you should be doing by yourself and with teachers so you can effectively study by yourself and know what to do with teachers, like me. 
We will mainly be doing Speaking and Grammar classes.
Speaking classes consist in speaking about advanced topics that I already have or generated by ChatGPT, speaking about or narrating content you have watched, and me speaking to you in a more advanced way. I have many technological resources that we can use to make personalized classes. These classes should be fun, creative, and customized to your preferences. You need to watch shows, see movies, listen to podcasts, read books and then be excited to talk to me about them and answer questions that AI generates. 

Grammar classes will be literally THE OPPOSITE of traditional schools. I will make you a large list of all the grammar rules you need to know with links. We will pick 1 grammar to work on at a time. You will read the rule aloud to me and we will read many example sentences and integrate AI if we need more. pro_course_detail.title: Free Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
The Free Conversation lesson is an informal and relaxed lesson designed to help you practice your English conversational skills. This program is ideal for those who want to improve their confidence in speaking English and practice using the language in a natural setting.

Objectives:

The objectives of this lesson are to provide you with opportunities to practice your conversational skills, increase your fluency, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills.

Program Outline:

The lesson is informal and flexible, and there is no specific outline or structure. The program allows for free-flowing conversation and can cover a range of topics and themes picked specifically by the student. The program's approach is student-led, and the teacher will facilitate the conversation based on the student's interests and preferences.
Each session of the Free Conversation Program allows for the student to have an opportunity to speak while also receiving feedback and correction from the teacher. The program's informal and relaxed nature allows for the student to feel comfortable and confident while speaking.

By participating in this lesson, you will have opportunities to practice your conversational skills, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills. The program is designed to be flexible and adaptable, allowing for a range of topics and themes to be explored during the conversation while making the student feel relaxed, comfortable, and confident while speaking.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
I know that not everybody learns the same way. For conversation practice I prefer to correct as things come up so they are fresh in your mind. I also like to use news articles or short stories about topics you like to help you understand grammar and learn new words. I also like to use other resources like games and apps to help you maintain what you learn after our lessons.

I prefer to do conversation based learning but can go over basic lessons as well depending on your interests and goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice your speaking skills with a native speaker. Get corrections in real time and get the chance to learn about fun, new topics.
In your first lesson with me, we will have casual conversation where we will discuss your goals while also getting to know one another. I will offer corrections and explanations as needed and I *always* encourage questions. In future lessons we might also use videos (I love TedTalks), articles, and other tools like tongue twisters and games to challenge & improve your language skills.

I know practicing your non-native language can be a little scary and I strive to make sure my students always feel comfortable in class with me. First and foremost, I never expect perfection. In fact, I love mistakes! Mistakes are one of our greatest teachers. 

I like to keep a casual, low-stress environment during lessons while always being sure to provide constructive corrections to keep you progressing.

Note for lessons with kids: I find that I am most effective working with adults but I will work with young adults pending prior approval. If you are interested in booking lessons for your child, please message me before booking.
